title: Coach Michelle on the Court
style: warm jazz pop, female lead vocal sweet and dreamy, soft piano, brushed drums, upright bass, light vibraphone, sunny uplifting, 98 bpm
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Michelle is a coach, Michelle is a friend
Shows you the line from start to end
Gentle little drop, soft little spin
Michelle is the teacher you want to play with

[Verse 2]
Little bright ball, sunny little day
Michelle on the court showing the way
Soft hands, soft feet, soft little smile
Michelle could play here for a long while

[Chorus]
Coach Michelle, on the court today
Gentle little game, gentle little play
Little bright ball, big sunny sky
Michelle is the reason that we all try

[Verse 3]
Patience and touch, eyes on the line
Michelle is taking her time
No big swing, no big sound
Michelle is the calmest player around

[Chorus]
Coach Michelle, on the court today
Gentle little game, gentle little play
Little bright ball, big sunny sky
Michelle is the reason that we all try

[Bridge]
Soft game, soft heart
Michelle teaches every part
Little bright ball, gentle as a breeze
Michelle plays with grace and ease

[Outro]
Coach Michelle…
Little bright ball forever…
Michelle and her players… together…
